next.headline: admin@338: a threat actor known from a catalogue record
next.in_short: The catalogue lists admin@338 and a set of tools tied to it. No public report in this library describes its operations.

sentences.t: The catalogue record, sourced from MITRE, names this actor admin@338 and lists no other aliases.
The record lists these tools: BUBBLEWRAP, LOWBALL, Systeminfo, PoisonIvy, netstat and ipconfig.
No public report in this library describes its operations.
